[EN] Mission Orders

Monsters are blocking the entrance to Sienna Canyon.

Kill the {@LinkCreature:38#1#sentinel officers}, {@LinkCreature:38#2#lurking rockcrawlers}, {@LinkCreature:38#44#ruinswalker demons}, {@LinkCreature:38#15#arbosk enchanters}, and {@LinkCreature:38#16#deskera imps}.

Report to Slevene when mission is complete.

Los monstruos están bloqueando la entrada a Sienna Canyon.

Mata a los {@LinkCreature:38#1#sentinel officers}, {@LinkCreature:38#2#lurking rockcrawlers}, {@LinkCreature:38#44#ruinswalker demons}, {@LinkCreature:38#15#arbosk enchanters} y {@LinkCreature:38#16#deskera imps}.

Infórmale a Slevene cuando termines la misión.
